standard.summary: 使用 LLM（如 CLIP/BLIP）提供语义指导来辅助底模微调，实现更高质量的语义对齐。Level 5 最高级特性。
standard.effect: architecture_mode 选择 hybrid（混合 LLM 语义 + 标准训练）或 pure（纯语义驱动）。需要指定 semantic_llm_path 和 semantic_projector_path。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性研究——探索语义引导的微调方法。
standard.avoidWhen: 日常训练不需要。需要额外的 LLM 模型和 projector 权重。

standard_en.summary: Uses an LLM (CLIP/BLIP, say) to provide semantic guidance that assists base-model finetuning, for higher-quality semantic alignment. A Level 5 top-tier feature.
standard_en.effect: architecture_mode chooses between hybrid (LLM semantics mixed with standard training) and pure (purely semantics-driven). It needs semantic_llm_path and semantic_projector_path to be set.
standard_en.whenToUse: Experimental research -- exploring semantically guided finetuning methods.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for everyday training. It requires an extra LLM model and projector weights.

advanced.principle: Semantic Tuner 使用预训练 LLM 提取图像和文本的语义表示，通过 projector 将语义信息注入到底模微调过程中。hybrid 模式同时使用标准 diffusion loss 和语义对齐 loss；pure 模式只使用语义信号。semantic_llm_path 指定 LLM 模型路径，semantic_projector_path 指定投影层路径。
advanced.intervention: 在 forward 中额外计算语义对齐 loss，与标准 loss 加权合并。
advanced.expectedImpact: 理论上提升语义对齐质量。实际效果高度依赖 LLM 和 projector 的质量。
advanced.tradeoffs: 计算开销大（需要额外 LLM forward）。实验性特性。

advanced_en.principle: Semantic Tuner uses a pretrained LLM to extract semantic representations of images and text, injecting the semantic information into base-model finetuning through a projector. hybrid mode uses both the standard diffusion loss and a semantic alignment loss; pure mode uses only the semantic signal. semantic_llm_path specifies the LLM model path, semantic_projector_path the projector path.
advanced_en.intervention: During the forward pass it additionally computes the semantic alignment loss, merged with the standard loss by weighted sum.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: In theory improves semantic alignment quality; actual effect depends heavily on the quality of the LLM and projector.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: High compute cost (needs an extra LLM forward). Experimental feature.
